title.zh: 修订《修订行政法典》第182条，准许总土地登记局在该局签发或经该局签发的所有文书中使用本局印章而非初审法院印章的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Section One Hundred and Eighty-Two of the Revised Administrative Code so as to Allow the General Land Registration Office to Use its Own Seal Instead of that of Courts of First Instance in All Processes Issued by or Through Said Office
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section One Hundred and Eighty-Two of the Revised Administrative Code so as to Allow the General Land Registration Office to Use its Own Seal Instead of that of Courts of First Instance in All Processes Issued by or Through Said Office

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1947/ra_94_1947.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section one hundred and eighty-two of the Revised Administrative Code is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 182. Seal to be used in General Land Registration Office. — All decrees, processes, documents and papers which require a seal and which are issued by or through the General Land Registration Office shall have the seal of said office affixed thereto."<<

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 17, 1947.
